user.title: SimpleX Chat
user.description:
Connect Home Assistant to a running SimpleX Chat CLI instance (WebSocket mode).

Default: `ws://127.0.0.1:5225`

If Home Assistant and simplex-bridge both use host networking on the same Linux host, use `ws://127.0.0.1:5225`.

error.cannot_connect: Unable to connect to the SimpleX WebSocket. Make sure `simplex-chat -p 5225` is running.

abort.already_configured: This WebSocket URL is already configured.
